post.summary: Trigger a 50-run Monte Carlo optimisation and return a ranked VIN sequence

post.description: Accepts a list of VINs and live constraint snapshot. Executes 50 Monte Carlo runs via KServe. Returns ranked sequence within 45 s; falls back to rule-based heuristic if timeout or model error occurs.

post.summary: Publish a locked VIN sequence to Siemens OpCenter 10.2

200.description: Sequence already published (idempotent replay) — returns cached response

202.description: Sequence accepted — either published to OpCenter (status=published) or queued for retry (status=queued)

403.description: Caller does not have sequence-publish role

409.description: Conflicting publish in progress for the same sequencePlanId

422.description: OpCenter rejected the sequence (e.g., unsigned upload, invalid VIN)

post.description: Accepts a finalised VIN sequence from planning-cockpit, signs it with the Planning Cockpit API key, and forwards it to OpCenter via HTTPS/REST. If OpCenter is unavailable, the job is queued with 30-second retry. Source field is always 'planning-cockpit'. Idempotent on idempotencyKey.

get.summary: Retrieve the full digital thread for a VIN — all manufacturing events from body-in-white through final quality gate, ordered by timestamp.

200.description: Digital thread events for the requested VIN

400.description: Invalid VIN format or query parameters

403.description: Caller lacks required role (quality-engineer or quality-lead)

404.description: VIN not found in the digital thread graph

500.description: Internal server error or Neo4j query failure

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character ISO 3779 Vehicle Identification Number

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous response

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of thread events to return (1–200)

parameters.name: shopFilter
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of shop codes to restrict results (e.g. PAINT,BODY,ASSEMBLY)

parameters.name: fromTs
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp — return only events at or after this time

parameters.name: toTs
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp — return only events at or before this time

post.summary: Anchor a Digital Birth Certificate to Hyperledger Fabric

200.description: Certificate already anchored (idempotent replay) — returns existing record

409.description: Conflict — certificateId already anchored with different payload (hash mismatch)

502.description: Fabric peer unavailable or transaction endorsement failed

504.description: Fabric transaction commit timed out (> 55 s)

post.description: Accepts a certificate payload (VIN, gate results snapshot, health score, validator ID, timestamp, certificate hash), submits a Fabric transaction, and returns the Fabric transaction hash. Idempotent on certificateId — a duplicate submission returns the existing transaction hash without creating a new ledger entry.

opcenterError.description: Raw error message from OpCenter if rejected

alertType.description: predictive = threshold-rule based from Beckhoff PLC trace; reactive = post-failure

stationId.description: Station identifier (station-level, not operator-level per GDPR/BetrVG)

opcenterEventId.description: Source event ID from OpCenter GraphQL subscription

minutesToPredictedFailure.description: Countdown in minutes; null for reactive alerts

next_cursor.description: Opaque; null on the last page

gateId.description: e.g., GATE-DIM, GATE-LEAK, GATE-ELEC, GATE-NVH, GATE-ADAS

measuredAt.description: UTC timestamp of measurement in OpCenter

receivedFromOpcenterAt.description: UTC timestamp when this service received the event from OpCenter

AlertStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a cluster alert

measuredAt.description: UTC timestamp of the OEE measurement in OpCenter

dataAgeSeconds.description: Seconds since measuredAt; consumers use this to detect staleness

vin.description: 17-character VIN this event is linked to

shop.description: Shop code where the event occurred (e.g. PAINT, BODY, ASSEMBLY)

eventId.description: Stable unique identifier for this event node in the graph

station.description: Station identifier within the shop (anonymised to station level per GDPR)

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when this event was written to the digital thread graph

dataSource.description: Originating system identifier (e.g. BECKHOFF_PLC_WELD_CELL_7, OPCENTER, UNS)

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the event occurred at the physical station

parameters.description: Key-value map of process parameters captured at this event (e.g. ecoat_voltage_v, phosphate_concentration_g_l, humidity_pct, temperature_c)

stageNumber.description: Paint prep stage number 1–14; null for non-paint events

tunnelPositionMm.description: VIN position in the prep tunnel in millimetres at the time of this event; null for non-tunnel events

ClusterStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a defect cluster

process_replay_url.description: Deep link to Process Replay for most recent affected VIN

plannerId.description: Entra ID subject claim of the planner

oeeDeltaPct.description: OEE delta: current shift vs. 30-day average per weld line (positive = above average)

kittingRules.description: Kitting rule overrides for MY26 variants

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key; same key returns cached result within 10 minutes

my26ConfigVersion.description: MY26 config version UUID if applicable

constraintMappings.description: Constraint model keys this option code maps to

factor_name.description: Human-readable factor label, e.g. 'e-coat voltage drop at stage 6'

optionCodes.description: BMW option codes for this VIN

dataSource.description: UNS topic or constraint model field that supplied this factor

resultType.description: Indicates whether the result is from Monte Carlo optimisation or the rule-based heuristic fallback

traceData.description: Raw PLC torque/angle trace samples (1kHz or 100Hz)

edgeBuffered.description: True when submitted from edge buffer after UNS reconnection

idempotencyKey.description: PLC-generated idempotency key; prevents duplicate log on retry

isVariantDelta.description: True if this step differs from standard i4 configuration

variantDeltaNote.description: Human-readable description of what differs for this variant

vinStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the VIN in the manufacturing process

affected_vins.description: List of affected VINs (anonymised to station level in exports)

unsLatencyMs.description: UNS p99 latency at snapshot time in ms

ConstraintSnapshot.description: Live constraint values fetched from UNS at the time of the optimisation request

callMode.description: Determined by Works Council approval flag stored server-side

details.description: Optional free-text detail or anomaly description

GateResultSnapshot.description: Snapshot of all gate station results at time of certification

opcenterConnected.description: Whether the GraphQL subscription to OpCenter is active

pendingPublishCount.description: Number of sequence publish jobs in queued/retrying state

opcenterApiKeyRotationDue.description: Date when the OpCenter API key must be rotated (90-day max)

vin_filter.description: Optional list of VINs to scope the query; omit for all recent VINs

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied idempotency key; same key returns cached result within 5 minutes

time_window_hours.description: Rolling time window in hours for cluster detection

samples.description: Time-ordered parameter samples for this stage

available.description: False when no data was received for this stage (OQ-6 partial traceability scenario)

stageName.description: Human-readable stage name (e.g. Pre-Degreasing, Phosphating, E-Coat)

override_root_cause.description: Free-text override if engineer disagrees with all top-5 factors

fallbackPdfQrUrl.description: QR code URL for fallback PDF; always populated

replayWindowEnd.description: Latest timestamp in the replay dataset

replayWindowStart.description: Earliest timestamp in the replay dataset

overallCompletenessPercent.description: Percentage of expected parameter samples that are present across all 14 prep stages

source.description: Must always be 'planning-cockpit' — OpCenter rejects any other value

lockedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the planner locked the sequence

plannerUserId.description: BMW Entra ID subject of the planner who locked the sequence

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key; duplicate submissions with same key return the cached response

sequencePlanId.description: UUID of the VIN sequence plan from postgresql-citus vinsequenceplan table

stageName.description: Name of the prep stage the VIN was in at the requested timestamp; null if outside paint prep

parameters.description: All parameter values interpolated or last-known at the requested timestamp

stageNumber.description: Prep stage number 1–14 at the requested timestamp; null if outside paint prep

dataAvailable.description: False when the requested timestamp falls in a data gap (OQ-6 scenario)

tunnelPositionMm.description: VIN position in the prep tunnel in millimetres at the requested timestamp

corrective_action_jira_id.description: Jira ticket ID if corrective action already created

shiftId.description: Shift identifier — used for shift export grouping (AC-fb3fae1c)

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the certify action in quality-studio

healthScore.description: Unified vehicle health score at time of certification (0–100)

validatorId.description: BMW Entra ID subject (sub claim) of the certifying Quality Gate Validator

sourceSystem.description: Originating system — enables A7 metric (≥90% certs via quality-studio)

certificateId.description: Client-generated UUID for idempotency key — must be stable across retries

certificateHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical certificate payload (computed by caller before submission)

confirmed_by_user_id.description: BMW Entra ID subject claim of the confirming engineer

status.description: published = confirmed by OpCenter; queued = OpCenter unavailable, retry pending; failed = permanent error

syncJobId.description: Internal sync job ID for tracking

publishedAt.description: UTC timestamp of successful OpCenter confirmation; null if queued

auditEventId.description: ID of the immutable audit log entry for this publish action

opcenterSequenceId.description: Sequence ID returned by Siemens OpCenter 10.2 API

missingParameters.description: List of parameter names with no data for this stage

anchoredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Fabric transaction was committed

idempotent.description: True if this response was served from an existing record (duplicate submission)

certificateHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest echoed back for caller verification

fabricBlockNumber.description: Fabric block number in which the transaction was committed

fabricTransactionId.description: Hyperledger Fabric transaction ID (hex string) — the immutable anchor reference

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID; duplicate submissions with the same key return 409

verified.description: True if the stored certificate hash matches the Fabric ledger entry

fabricHash.description: SHA-256 hash retrieved from the Fabric ledger (null if Fabric query failed)

storedHash.description: SHA-256 hash stored in the local database

cluster_alert_min_vins.description: Minimum number of VINs sharing a root-cause signature to trigger an alert

cluster_alert_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for a cluster to trigger a real-time alert

low_confidence_threshold.description: Below this score a Low Confidence badge is shown and Advisor v1 fallback is displayed

cluster_alert_window_hours.description: Rolling window in hours for cluster alert detection

eventId.description: UUID assigned to the newly created event node in the graph

linkedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the event was linked to the VIN node in Neo4j
